entry.title: Why a cap
entry.summary: A section with hundreds of pages puts hundreds of links in every page's sidebar.
entry.content:
Starlight lists every page of a folder in the sidebar of every page. For a folder with a few pages that is what a reader wants. For a folder with hundreds of generated pages, every page of the site carries hundreds of links, and the build renders them again for every page.

A hub over its cap keeps its overview link and one entry that leads to the hub, where the pages are listed.
